interpretation_warning: This factor describes refined-product market tightness. It is not a production strategy gate and does not isolate demand from refinery outages, geopolitics, seasonality, or other supply effects.

methodology.jet_crack: US Gulf Coast jet spot USD/gal * 42 - Brent spot USD/bbl
methodology.diesel_crack: US Gulf Coast ULSD spot USD/gal * 42 - Brent spot USD/bbl
methodology.history_window: approximately trailing 5 years of aligned EIA daily observations
methodology.score: 70% average crack level percentile + 30% average 20-trading-day crack-change percentile

sources.provider: U.S. Energy Information Administration Open Data API

jet.name: U.S. Gulf Coast Kerosene-Type Jet Fuel Spot Price FOB

diesel.name: U.S. Gulf Coast Ultra-Low Sulfur No. 2 Diesel Spot Price
